# Data formats

What the pipeline stores for each document (`docs/<doc_id>/` in storage) and what the API returns. Types are Python annotations; `Decimal` values travel as strings.

## Document record (`DocRecord`)

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `doc_id` | `str` | required |
| `sha256` | `str` | required |
| `doc_type` | `Optional[Literal['rhp', 'drhp', 'prospectus']]` | — |
| `company` | `str \| None` | — |
| `pages` | `int \| None` | — |
| `uploaded_by` | `str \| None` | — |
| `is_showcase` | `bool` | false |
| `companion_of` | `str \| None` | — |
| `created_at` | `datetime` | required |
| `status` | `Literal['uploading', 'processing', 'ready', 'partial', 'failed']` | `processing` |
| `rejection` | `Optional[Literal['scanned', 'password', 'too_large', 'too_many_pages', 'not_offer_document', 'hash_mismatch']]` | — |

## Job (`Job`)

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `job_id` | `str` | required |
| `doc_id` | `str` | required |
| `stage` | `str` | required |
| `status` | `Literal['queued', 'running', 'done', 'failed']` | required |
| `progress` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` |
| `error` | `str \| None` | — |
| `started_at` | `datetime \| None` | — |
| `finished_at` | `datetime \| None` | — |

## Result files (`eval_results/`)

Every experiment writes one JSON file with its `experiment` id, the `git_sha`, the numbers with their `n` and 95 % intervals, and `notes`. The [evaluation page](../evaluation.md) lists which files exist.
